'''Yavin 8''' was one of three habitable [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that orbited the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. Located in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], it was a cold and arid moon and the home of the [[Melodie]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Geographic features==
[[File:Sistra_Mountain.png|thumb|left|200px|Sistra Mountain.]]

Yavin 8 was an arid, cold world covered in vast expanses of snow and brown tundra. Though water was abundant on Yavin 8 because of its vast expanses of snow and tundra, it was only found in liquid form within the rivers and lakes of its equatorial purple mountain ranges.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> Occasionally, the snow and tundra melted during spring thaws which resulted in floods.

Yavin 8's equatorial mountain ranges were inhabited by the moon's sole sentient species, the [[Melodie]]s. They were amphibious humanoids that spent the rest of their lives underwater once having reached the age of twenty in which they changed their form during the [[Changing Ceremony]].<ref name="JJK:LW">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World]]''</ref> A humanoid race also lived on the moon. The race earned the enmity of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who initiated its genocide. The only survivor was [[Tarron Neb]].<ref name="SWGM7">{{GalaxyCite|7|Design An Alien}}</ref>

Other lifeforms native to the moon included various fish species that inhabited the moon's rivers and lakes and several predatory species including the bird-like [[Avril]], the serpentine [[Reel]], the rodent-like [[Raith (rodent)|Raith]] and the spidery [[Purella]].<ref name="JJK:LW" /><ref name="TEGtPaM" />

==History==
Due to its remote location, Yavin 8 was largely unknown to the rest of the galaxy. In [[3997 BBY]], during the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] reign over the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] of nearby [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], he imprisoned their children in a spherical [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] device known as the [[Golden Globe]] for the purpose of both controlling the Massassi and to drain the life energies of its trapped captives. The desperate Massassi parents came to Yavin 8 to seek help and met the children of the Melodies. The children took them to their Elders but they could offer no help since they were unable to leave the waters.<ref name="JJK:LW" />

Thus, the Massassi engraved messages in the rocks and caves of Yavin 8 so that somebody may read them some day and come to their aid. However, these messages were written in the [[Massassi (language)|Massassi tongue]], which made it difficult for non-speakers to understand them.<ref name="JJK:LW" />
Worse, the Massassi were wiped out in [[3996 BBY]] during the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|Jedi/Republic]] assault on the jungle moon. This piece of history would only be preserved in the form of legends by storytellers known as "[[Keeper of Legends]]."<ref name="JJK:LW" /><ref name="TEGtPaM" />

[[File:Reel.jpg|200px|thumb|[[Anakin Solo]], [[Tahiri Veila]] and the Melodies confronting a reel.]]

Millennia later, during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Melodies were discovered by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Suz Tanwa]] though they were only officially discovered in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]] which had set up a [[Jedi Praxeum]] on Yavin 4. On that same year, a young Melodie named [[Lyric]] left her home of Sistra to study at [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on Yavin 4 after being discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Her parents allowed her to go because of the dangerous conditions of their homeworld. Later, when Lyric returned to Yavin 8 to undergo the Changing Ceremony in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], Jedi trainees [[Anakin Solo]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] escorted Lyric to her homeworld to undergo the Changing Ceremony. During their trip, they fell under attack by native carnivores including an avril, a reel, a purella and a number of raiths though Anakin, Tahiri and their Melodie allies fought them off.<ref name="JJK:LW" /><ref name="TEGtPaM" />

It was also from the Keeper of Legends [[Aragon]] that Anakin and Tahiri learned about the existence of the ancient [[Massassi (alphabet)|Massassi carvings]]. They discovered these carvings in a cave. During their trip on Yavin 8, Anakin and Tahiri also met [[Sannah]], whom they discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and took her with them during their home trip to Yavin 4. Later, Sannah assisted them in translating the ancient Massassi carvings. They then learned of the origins of the Golden Globe and how to defeat it.<ref name="JJK:LW" /><ref name="TEGtPaM" />

Shortly after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Invasion of Yavin 4|destroyed]] the Jedi Praxeum in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong presumably conquered Yavin 8. The extragalactic invaders also unleashed deadly Jedi-hunting [[Voxyn]] on the moon. Among their victims were Lyric.<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]] was the first source to indicate that only three of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime's]] moons could support [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] life.
